$comment: Third-person boom tuning. The boom marches from the player's focus point toward the camera and pulls in short of terrain or building colliders; see src/entities/CameraBoom.ts.

boom.$comment_steps: Sample points along the boom. Six matched the old inline march; building walls are thin enough at this distance that more samples buys little and costs a query per step.
boom.$comment_floor: Camera never sits closer than this, or a corner pull-in puts it inside the player's own head.
boom.$comment_groundClearance: Height above the sampled terrain the boom must clear before it counts as blocked.
boom.$comment_colliderMargin: Extra radius added to each collider before testing the boom sample against it. A wall collider's radius alone stops the camera AT the wall; from there the near face is still close enough to the lens to disappear at a glancing angle. The margin buys a hair of standoff so the wall reads as solid.
boom.$comment_lerp: Rates are 1 - exp(-rate * dt) blends, not raw per-frame fractions, so they read the same at any framerate. Pulling in must be quick enough that a wall never gets a frame to show through; easing back out is slower so the boom does not visibly snap to full length the instant a corner clears.
